preview.overview: Baylor brings the lineal belt into Ames to face an Iowa State team hungry to reclaim it in a rivalry that has shifted dramatically in recent years. The belt will change hands if Iowa State can pull off the upset, continuing a trend that has seen these teams trade the championship back and forth since 2020.
key_matchups: Baylor's offensive consistency versus Iowa State's defensive struggles—Baylor scored 41, 55, and 23 points in recent wins while Iowa State allowed 39, 24, and 31 points in recent losses
Iowa State's explosive capability in close games—the Cyclones won 51-49 over Oklahoma State and 45-42 over West Virginia, showing they can compete in shootouts
Turnover differential and red zone execution in a rivalry where five of the last five meetings have been decided by 9 points or fewer
preview.betting_angles: Iowa State has won three of the last five head-to-head meetings and claimed the belt in 2024 with a 43-21 victory, suggesting the Cyclones have found an answer to Baylor's formula. However, Baylor's recent form is stronger—three wins in their last five with offensive explosiveness (41, 55, 23 points)—compared to Iowa State's 2-3 stretch that includes blowout losses to Arizona (39-3) and Utah (31-17). The series remains razor-thin, with nearly every game decided by single digits, making this a classic toss-up despite the belt holder's edge.
preview.prediction_writeup: Baylor's recent offensive output and Iowa State's defensive inconsistency give the belt holder the edge in this tight rivalry matchup. While Iowa State's ability to win close games and their 3-2 head-to-head advantage in the last five meetings is real, Baylor's three consecutive wins and 55-point outburst against Arizona State suggest they're playing with more confidence right now. Iowa State has shown vulnerability to good offensive teams, allowing 39 points to Arizona and 24 to BYU, and Baylor's attack has been potent enough to exploit that. The Cyclones will likely keep it close—they always do—but Baylor's current form carries them to a narrow home-field hold of the belt.
